insights.headline: Gold and silver extended their sell-off as oil-driven inflation fears hardened bets on another Fed rate hike.
insights.summary: MCX October gold futures fell 2.42% to ₹1,47,225 per 10 grams and December silver dropped 3.22% to ₹2,27,133 per kg on Monday, tracking COMEX gold below $4,200 to a seven-week low. Indian gold and silver ETFs tumbled up to 4% in sympathy while the rupee closed at 96.03 per dollar as Brent crude held near $108. Kotak flagged a sharp fall in gold imports since May's duty hike to 15%, and Nomura put an 80% probability on 25-50 bps of RBI rate hikes by December.
points: MCX gold fell 2.42% to ₹1,47,225/10g; silver down 3.22% to ₹2,27,133/kg as oil and rate-hike bets drove selling.
Gold and silver ETFs tumbled up to 4%, mirroring bullion; rupee closed at 96.03/$ with crude elevated.
Kotak: gold imports fell sharply since May's duty hike to 15%; festive demand may revive flows.
Nomura sees an 80% chance of 25-50 bps RBI hikes by December ahead of the Oct 5-7 policy meeting.
UBS expects silver at $70 by December and $80 by September 2027 despite the current pressure.

trending.title: Rate-hike repricing crushes bullion
trending.summary: Oil-driven inflation fears have markets pricing a ~68% chance of an October Fed hike, lifting yields and the dollar and hammering non-yielding metals on MCX and COMEX alike.

trending.title: Rupee at 96.03 compounds the fall
trending.summary: The rupee closed at 96.03 per dollar as crude stayed elevated, lifting the landed cost of gold for Indian buyers even as MCX futures slid.

trending.title: Import slump tests festive demand
trending.summary: Kotak notes gold imports have fallen sharply since the May duty hike, with households pausing; the festive season will show whether demand revives or shifts further to ETFs and digital gold.

trending.title: Silver's split outlook
trending.summary: Silver fell harder than gold, but analysts stay constructive: UBS sees $80 by September 2027 while technicals eye $60 support into NFP week.

items.title: Gold, silver plunge up to 3% as oil surge, rate-hike bets trigger sell-off. What lies ahead?
items.summary: MCX October gold futures fell 2.42% to Rs 1,47,225 per 10 grams and December silver futures dropped 3.22% to Rs 2,27,133 per kg as surging crude and rising US yields revived bets on another Fed rate hike in October. Analysts cited by ET put immediate MCX gold support at Rs 1,47,300-1,48,000, with US inflation and jobs data due this week seen as the next trigger.

Indian gold and silver ETFs tumbled up to 4% on Monday, mirroring the sharp fall in bullion as Fed rate-hike bets strengthened. The slide tracked MCX futures lower, with higher US yields and a firm dollar cited as the immediate triggers.
items.title: Why Gold, silver ETFs tumbled over 4% today | What's behind the fall and what should investors do?

items.summary: Spot gold slid to a seven-week low below $4,200 on Monday as surging oil prices on the US-Iran standoff stoked inflation fears and bets on further Fed rate hikes, lifting Treasury yields and the dollar. Markets see a 70.3% chance of a Fed hike in October. Silver fell alongside ahead of US PCE and jobs data.
items.title: Gold hits 7-week low as oil-driven inflation fears boost rate-hike bets
Surge in crude oil prices continue to pressurize INR
items.summary: The rupee fell 28 paise to close at 96.03 per dollar on Monday as the US rejection of Iran's proposal dimmed hopes of the Strait of Hormuz reopening, keeping Brent crude near $108. Elevated oil and firm US yields are likely to keep pressuring the rupee, which keeps domestic gold prices elevated even when global prices fall.

Nomura expects the RBI to raise rates by a cumulative 25-50 basis points by December — assigning an 80% probability — ahead of the October 5-7 policy meeting, while dismissing market fears of 125 bps of hikes over the next year. It sees a terminal repo rate of 5.75%, arguing a full tightening cycle is unlikely.
items.title: Will RBI announce steep rate hikes? Nomura sees up to 50 bps increase by Dec, dismisses 125 bps hike fears

items.summary: UBS expects silver to recover to $70 an ounce by December 2026 and reach $80 by September 2027, via $75 in March and June 2027, citing support from higher gold prices and tighter near-term physical fundamentals — while cautioning that a more hawkish Fed remains a near-term headwind.

items.summary: In its Questor weekly outlook, the Telegraph's Russ Mould argues silver looks poised to follow in gold's footsteps — holding steady around $60 after retreating from $117 highs and forming a base.
items.title: Why silver could shine again
Gold and Silver plunge at weekly open: Can month-end flows and NFP spark a reversal?
items.summary: Gold broke below $4,225 support toward $4,143 and silver fell through $62.30 toward $60.90 at the week's open as hawkish Fed expectations, rising oil and a 10-year yield near 5.23% pressured metals. FXStreet notes month-end flows could spark volatility, while Friday's US jobs report may decide whether the sell-off extends or reverses.
